wall_adapter.packing: Exact product embedded specification/packing page lists PSU-5V4A-5.5-2.1-CN x1. Two ordered units include two fixed leads.
wall_adapter.certification_evidence: Official parameters list CCC and the official label photo visibly carries CCC and centre-positive markings. Independent certificate registry status was not checked.
wall_adapter.method: Normal public HTTP GET of official product HTML and its embedded specifications/packing content; official label photo inspected; catalogue price independently re-read.
wall_adapter.limitations: Public catalogue price is not a stock reservation or a checkout quotation. Confirm exact CN SKU, actual delivery, tax and final shipping before any order.
wall_adapter.application: Supplies A2 J1 centre-positive DC charge input; it is not a direct battery charger. On-board BQ25170 remains the sole cell charger. Validate loaded input 4.75–5.25 V and DC_PROTECTED >=4.60 V.
wall_adapter.budget_replacement: Replaces two USB wall chargers plus two separate USB-A-to-DC5521 charging leads. Do not add the removed charging-lead line again. RUN and maintenance USB cables remain separate.

core_and_run_power.core_price_evidence_note: Reuses the current team sourcing result recorded in 采购核验记录_20261119.md; this supplemental power review did not independently refresh the core price.
core_and_run_power.allocation: Two USB cables stay intact for ordinary computer maintenance; two are shortened/terminated by the assembler into J4-to-USB-C RUN leads. Cable goods price excludes labour and PH terminals.
core_and_run_power.electrical_boundary: RUN connects only VBUS/GND through the core native USB-C. Verify source-plug CC 56k resistance, polarity, voltage drop, insulation and strain relief on each assembled lead. Remove RUN plug before inserting a computer cable into that same socket. Core BAT/VBAT/3V3 stay unconnected.

shipping.rate_status: Official lightweight first-weight reference prices only, not an address/weight checkout quote.
shipping.free_shipping_claim: Not established. Official FAQ says buyer pays below CNY800 and shipping may be negotiated above that amount; no CNY99-free-shipping assumption.
shipping.consolidation: SKUs 30306, 26938 and 35944 share the Waveshare CN store and are candidates for one order/dispatch. Count shipping once only if the final order confirms consolidation; combined weight, availability and destination remain unverified.
shipping.example_limit: Examples assume the published CNY8 first-weight rate applies. They are not complete project costs, not guaranteed combined shipping, and exclude any assembly/termination service.

verified_public_capabilities: About page explicitly states no minimum order quantity, including single prototypes
independent_harness_service_check.qualification_scope: Official site claims raw-material batch inspection and IPC assembly practices. No independent audit/certificate assessment was performed for this precise custom job.
independent_harness_service_check.pricing: Homepage advertises assembly starting at CNY1; this is not a price for H1/H2/H3, two complete devices, battery NTC attachment, tests or shipping. No task-specific quote was obtained.
independent_harness_service_check.quotation_workflow: Official submission form requires drawings/contact details; it says engineering contact within two working days, followed by technical discussion and an exact quote.
remaining_acceptance: Confirm six exact H1/H2/H3 harnesses and connector pinouts
Confirm protected battery lead handling and real NTC attachment without bypassing PCM
Confirm USB-C source plug CC/polarity and current tests
Confirm willingness to perform final device assembly and individual cold/hot electrical acceptance, or obtain a separate assembler
Confirm complete fee, minimum processing charge, shipping and lead time
independent_harness_service_check.conclusion: Credible official no-MOQ enquiry route, but no verified cheaper complete alternative yet. Do not reduce the retail-pack or assembly budget on the basis of the starting-price advertisement.

rejected_or_unpriced_shortlist.reason: Reviewed official versions use a different barrel size; not a drop-in 5521 choice.
